topic: 限时写作：流程、地图与阶段测评
grammarFocus: 被动、顺序、地点、变化及句子间衔接。
title: Timed Writing Practice: Opinion Essay on Staged Assessment
prompt: Some people believe that university students should be assessed through a series of short, frequent tests spread across each term, while others argue that a single major examination at the end of the term is a fairer and more meaningful measure of ability. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion. In your essay, consider the effects of each assessment style on how students prepare and on the reliability of the final result. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为限时写作练习（建议40分钟）。请先花约5分钟审题并列出双方观点与自己的立场，再用约30分钟完成不少于250词的议论文，最后留约5分钟检查。注意：题目要求讨论两种观点并给出自己的明确立场，三个部分缺一不可；请用具体理由和例子支撑，不要只罗列优缺点。本练习中的所有情境与数据均为模拟，并非官方雅思试题。
